reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Composition v1 schema: 1 default changed: `spec.mode`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Compositions that leave spec.mode unset now default to Pipeline instead of Resources, so they are interpreted differently.
consequence.remediation: Set spec.mode explicitly (e.g. Resources) on Compositions that rely on the old default, or verify they work as Pipeline.

proposed.statement: The default of Composition spec.mode (apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1) changed from "Resources" to "Pipeline" for objects that leave it unset.
